BASIC BODICE BLOCK
17.1
INTRODUCTION
The bodice block is of great importance in dress designing. This paper pattern is made
with standard ease or looseness forstandard measurements or forindividual measurements.
This does not contain any allowances for seams, overlap, turning, etc. The bodice block
is made upto the waist only. The paper pattern for any garment can be made with the'help
of the bodice block pattern. The bodice block pattern for ladies and children's garments
is made separately for upper and lower body. The dress block pattern for men's garments
is made for upper body and lower body - e.g. shirt pattern and pant pattern.
17.2
OBJECTIVES

17.3 BODICEBLOCK
The bodice block can be made either with standard or with individual measurements. The
markings for darts, balance, grainline, etc. are placed on it. A standard looseness is kept
but no allowance for seams, overlap or turning is marked. The bodice block is then cut,
on thin muslin or new markin cloth and draped over the dummy to check for correctness.

Thereafter, the paper pattern for the garment is made after adding the requisite looseness
to the block pattern.
'
17.4 TYPES OF BODICE BLOCK
There are many types of bodice blocks:-
1.
Child's basic bodice block
i)
Basic bodice block
These are made according to a child's measurements. They very with age. In the
.basic bodice block for children aged 1-3 years, the front portion is kept slightly
larger as children ofthis age group have a protruding abdomen. The bodice block
made for older children is different. The garment pattern is made with the help of
the basic block, e.g. - top, shirt, T-shirt, etc.
ii)
Sleeve block
The sleeve block is made in accordance with the bodice block. Modifications can
be made in the sleeve block according to the kind of sleeve desired in the garment.
iii)
Skirt block
A fit block is made for girls skirts. This can also be adapted according to the
design of the skirt.
2.
Bodice block for ladies
i)
Basic block
This block is made according to measurements and with the standard looseness.
It differs with measurements and with age. It can be manipulated to suit individual
requirements e.g. dart manipulation, fitting according to the figure and changes
according to the dress, e.g. - 'A' line suit, kalidaar suit, middi, etc.
ii)
Sleeve block
The sleeve block is made according to the basic block. It can be manipulated to
give fit or loose sleeve according to the fashion. It can also be adapted to make
different designs in sleeves.
-
iii)
Block for pyjamas - pant
-
The trouser block can be made according to given measurements
and also
manipulated according to designs, jeans, bellbottom, etc.
